details: Mandatory draw at start of turn
instructions: !Draw 1 card from _R&D_ (your deck) into _HQ_ (your hand)!. _(This is your mandatory draw — it happens at the start of every Corp turn.)_

details: Install face down in new remote server
instructions: The Corp has 3 available actions in each turn, represented by this icon: [click] (a _click_). Spend your first [click] to !install Superconducting Hub face down in a new remote server.!

details: Spend 1cr to place 1 advancement token; ID triggers: +2cr
instructions: Spend [click] and 1[credit] (a _credit_) to !advance the facedown card in your remote server!. You place its first advancement token on it, so your identity triggers: you gain 2[credit].

details: Install face down as outer ice on remote server
instructions: Spend your final [click] to !install Palisade face down as a piece of ICE protecting your remote server!, in the outermost position.

details: Pay 5cr, gain 9cr (net +4cr)
instructions: The Runner does not draw automatically at the start of their turn, but they have 4 available [click] (_clicks_) in each turn. Spend [click] and 5[credit] (_credits_) to !play Sure Gamble! from your _grip_ (your hand) to gain 9[credit].

details: Successful run on R&D. Draw 1 (Build Script). Access 2 cards. Access #1: steal Offworld Office (agenda). Access #2: see Tithe, leave on top. ID: +2cr.
instructions: Spend [click] to !play Jailbreak!, making a run on R&D. The run is successful, so you draw 1 card. Then you access 2 cards from R&D, one at a time. You access Offworld Office — you must steal this agenda and place it in your score area. You then access Tithe, which you must leave on top of R&D. Your identity triggers: since you accessed 2 cards, you gain 2[credit]. Offworld Office is worth 2 out of the 7 points you need to win. Since it was stolen and not scored, its ability does not trigger.

details: Runner approaches Palisade. Corp rezzes (3cr). No breaker → subs fire → ""End the run"". Run ends.
instructions: Spend [click] to !make a run on the remote server!. You approach the ICE protecting the remote. The Corp has now the opportunity to respond: !the Corp spends 3[credit] to rez Palisade!. You encounter the ICE with nothing installed to interface with it yet, so all its subroutines fire: End the run. The run ends unsuccesfully.

details: Draw 1 card
instructions:
Spend your final [click] to !draw 1 card! from your _stack_ (your deck) into your grip.",
Corp,2,0,5,draw,Tithe,,,,3,Mandatory draw,!Draw 1 card from R&D into HQ.! _(Mandatory draw.)_"

details: Hub → 2 tokens
instructions: !Advance Superconducting Hub!. It now has 2 tokens. _(This costs you [click] and 1[credit].)_

details: Advance to 3 tokens → score agenda. On score: draw 2 (Beanstalk Royalties + Regolith Mining License). Max hand size → 7.
instructions: !Advance Superconducting Hub! again. It now meets its advancement requirement. !Score it!: reveal it, place it in your score area, and remove all advancement counters from it. On score, Superconducting Hub triggers and you draw 2 cards. You will also have +2 hand size for as long as it remains in your score area. Superconducting Hub is worth 1 out of the 7 points you need to win.

details: Install face down on R&D
instructions: !Install Tithe face down protecting R&D.!

details: Pay 3cr.
instructions: !Install Desperado! from your grip. _(This costs you [click] and 3[credit].)_

details: Run on R&D. Corp rezzes Tithe (1cr). Can't break → subs: 1 net damage, Corp +1cr. Pass ice. Run successful. Desperado: +1cr. Access Enigma, leave on top. ID: +1cr.
instructions: !Make a run on R&D!. You approach the ICE protecting R&D. !The Corp rezzes Tithe! _(paying 1[credit])_. You cannot interface with it. All its subroutines fire: Take 1 net damage _(you discard 1 card at random — if you had no cards in hand and took damage, you would be _flatlined_ and lost the game)_, then the Corp gains 1[credit]. You pass the ice, since there were no 'End the run.' subroutines on Tithe. The run is successful. Desperado triggers: gain 1[credit]. Access 1 card from R&D — [TBD] you must leave it on top. Your identity triggers: you gain 1[credit].

details: Pay 3cr
instructions: !Install Verbal Plasticity.!

details: Verbal Plasticity: draw 2 instead → Clean Getaway, Curupira
instructions: Use the basic action to !draw 1 card!. Verbal Plasticity replaces this effect: you draw 2 cards instead.

details: Mandatory draw
instructions: !Draw 1 card from R&D into HQ.! _(Mandatory draw.)_

details: Gain 3cr
instructions: !Play Beanstalk Royalties! to gain 3[credit].

details: Install face down behind rezzed Palisade. Rez for 2cr (on rez: add 15cr onto card).
instructions: !Install Regolith Mining License face down in your remote server, behind Palisade.! Right after this action, !rez Regolith Mining License! by spending 2[credit]. _(The Corp has the opportunity to rez non-ICE cards at many times, such as before and after each click.)_ Place 15[credit] from the bank on Regolith Mining License.
teaching_moment: explain rezzing non ICE cards & timing

details: Take 3cr from Regolith's stored credits.
instructions: !Take the action on Regolith Mining License! to take 3[credit] from it and add them to your credit pool. _(This spends your final [click].)_

details: Pay 3cr. Run on HQ (no ice). Successful. Clean Getaway: +6cr. Desperado: +1cr. Access 1 random card. ID: +1cr.
instructions: !Play Clean Getaway.! This makes you run a server of your choice. !Choose HQ!, as it's currently unprotected. The run is successful, so Clean Getaway gives you 6[credit] and Desperado gives you 1[credit]. You access 1 random card from HQ. Your identity triggers: you gain 1[credit]. You reveal the accessed card.

details: Pay 3cr
instructions: !Install Curupira.!

details: Encounter Palisade. Use Curupira: pay 3cr for +3 strength, 1cr to break barrier sub → all subs broken. Add a counter to Curupira. Run succesful. Desperado: +1cr. Access Regolith, pay 3cr to trash.
instructions: Use the basic action to !make a run on the remote server!. You approach then encounter Palisade. !Use Curupira!: you !pay 3[credit] to increase its strength by 3!, matching Palisade's strength. Since the strength is equal or more than the ICE's, Curupira _interfaces_ with Palisade: you can now pay 1[credit] to break 1 _barrier_ subroutine. Palisade is indeed a barrier, so you decide to !break its single subroutine!. _(Since this piece of ICE was fully broken, a power counter is added to Curupira for later use.)_ You then pass the ICE and !proceed!. The run is succesful and Desperado triggers: you gain 1[credit]. You finally access Regolith Mining License and reveal it _(it does not become rezzed)_. This card can be trashed for 3[credit] (it has a little bin icon on the bottom right corner), so you decide to !trash it!.
teaching_moment: explain icebreakers: strength + interface + breaking subs; explain trashing & trash cost

details: Player is free to continue playing as they want.
instructions: Now you are on your own — you may take any action you want!
